readings: Across all invoices, including those with no line items, what is the average of each invoice's mean line-item `product_price` (missing prices ignored; an invoice with no non-missing price has no mean and is skipped), and what is the average number of line items per invoice, with an invoice that has no line items counting as zero? Return a single row with these two values, unrounded.
queries:
SELECT
  (SELECT AVG(m) FROM (
     SELECT AVG(product_price) AS m
     FROM Invoice_Line_Items
     GROUP BY invoice_number
     HAVING COUNT(product_price) > 0
  )) AS avg_of_mean_price,
  (SELECT AVG(c) FROM (
     SELECT COUNT(ili.invoice_number) AS c
     FROM Invoices i
     LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
     GROUP BY i.invoice_number
  )) AS avg_line_items_per_invoice;
